svg.title: One B-tree per partition
svg.desc: An animation in six steps. A matches table is partitioned by played_on into three partitions, one each for January, February, and March 2026. CREATE INDEX on matches (match_id) builds one B-tree in each partition and none for matches itself. A lookup for match 51042 then searches the three trees in turn: January's tree finds it, and the February and March trees are searched anyway. Adding UNIQUE (match_id) fails, because each tree checks only its own month, so a second 51042 dated in February would never meet the one in January. Adding UNIQUE (match_id, played_on) succeeds and builds a second tree in each partition, keyed by match id and date. Inserting match 51042 dated 2026-01-31 a second time lands in January, and January's tree refuses the duplicate pair. Inserting match 51042 dated 2026-02-01 is a new pair, so February's trees take it, and match 51042 is now in two months.
svg.text: An index on a partitioned table is one B-tree per partition, and each tree sees only its own partition's rows.
ERROR: UNIQUE constraint on partitioned table must include all partitioning columns
DETAIL: UNIQUE constraint on table "matches" lacks column "played_on" which is part of the partition key.
ALTER TABLE matches ADD UNIQUE (match_id, played_on);
ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "matches_2026_01_match_id_played_on_key"

g.text: holds no rows or index trees of its own

svg.text: match 51042 is now in January and in February
CREATE INDEX on matches builds one B-tree in each month's partition, and none for matches itself.
A lookup by match_id names no month, so all three trees are searched, even after January's tree finds 51042.
UNIQUE (match_id) is refused. Each tree checks only its own month, so a second 51042 in February would go unseen.
UNIQUE (match_id, played_on) includes the partition key, so it is accepted. It builds one more tree per month.
A repeated pair has the same date as its twin, so it lands in January, and January's tree refuses it.
But only duplicate pairs are ruled out. (51042, 2026-02-01) is a new pair, so match 51042 is now in two months.
